access_links.label: HUD Community Resilience Portal on the U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit

description: HUD Community Resilience Portal is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by HUD, U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development. This guide can help recipients of HUD Community Planning and Development (CPD) funds identify opportunities to use their CPD dollars to mitigate the impacts of natural related hazards. The toolkit addresses increasing temperatures and extreme heat, sea level rise and coastal storms, inland flooding, wildfire, drought, and erosion & landslides. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General, Wildfire. Assets: Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
